Feature activation helpers, generated IDs, map data, and build rules for Flamenco.


## Files
- **[fd_features.c](fd_features.c.md)**: Feature enable and disable helpers, including cleaned-up and one-off activation.
- **[fd_features.h](fd_features.h.md)**: Feature activation flags, IDs, and helper macros for querying and setting activation slots.
- **[fd_features_generated.c](fd_features_generated.c.md)**: Generated feature ID table and prefix lookup for fd_features_t.
- **[fd_features_generated.h](fd_features_generated.h.md)**: Generated feature-gate IDs and names in a union with 245 entries.
- **[feature_map.json](feature_map.json.md)**: Feature gate map with pubkeys and cleanup or revert flags.
- **[gen_features.py](gen_features.py.md)**: Generates fd_features_generated.h and fd_features_generated.c from feature_map.json.
- **[Local.mk](Local.mk.md)**: Build rules that add feature headers and objects when FD_HAS_INT128 is defined.
- **[Makefile](Makefile.md)**: The `Makefile` in the `firedancer/src/flamenco/features` directory automates the generation of feature files and formats the Python script using Black.
